$$
\begin{aligned}
  \operatorname{OGseed\_percent\_maincrop}_{i}  &\sim N \left(\mu, \sigma^2 \right) \\
    \mu &=\alpha_{j[i],k[i]} + \beta_{1}(\operatorname{legitimation\_user}) + \beta_{2}(\operatorname{CertifierRequestn}) + \beta_{3}(\operatorname{noncommercial\_seedsource\_s}) + \beta_{4}(\operatorname{acreage\_\log}) + \beta_{5}(\operatorname{cropcat\_n}) + \beta_{6}(\operatorname{years\_certified\_s}) \\
    \alpha_{j}  &\sim N \left(\gamma_{0}^{\alpha} + \gamma_{1}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{entrants\_supplychain\_n\_avg\_s}) + \gamma_{2}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{resources\_funding\_100thous}) + \gamma_{3}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{knowledge\_organicip\_10}), \sigma^2_{\alpha_{j}} \right)
    \text{, for Region j = 1,} \dots \text{,J} \\
    \alpha_{k}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{k}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{k}} \right)
    \text{, for maincrop k = 1,} \dots \text{,K}
\end{aligned}
$$


$$
\begin{aligned}
  \operatorname{Organic\ seed\ acreage\ (percent)}_{i}  &\sim N \left(\mu, \sigma^2 \right) \\
    \mu &=\alpha_{j[i],k[i]} + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{1}(\operatorname{Farm\ size}) + \\ 
                                  &\ \beta_{2}(\operatorname{Non\ commercial\ seed\ sourcing}) + \\
                                  &\ \beta_{3}(\operatorname{Value\ organic\ seed}) +  \\
                                  &\ \beta_{4}(\operatorname{Certifier\ request}) + \\
    \alpha_{j}  &\sim N (\gamma_{0}^{\alpha} + \\
                                                 &\ \gamma_{1}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Supplier\ entrants}) + \\
                                            &\ \gamma_{2}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Research\ funding}) + \\
                                             &\ \gamma_{3}^{\alpha}(\operatorname{Organic\ IP}), \\
                                             &\ \sigma^2_{\alpha_{j}})
    \text{, for Region j = 1,} \dots \text{,J} \\
    \alpha_{k}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\alpha_{k}}, \sigma^2_{\alpha_{k}} \right)
    \text{, for Main crop category k = 1,} \dots \text{,K}
\end{aligned}
$$
